deadline.value: The School has no set application deadline; some specific projects may have deadlines.
deadline.quote: The School of Biology has no set application deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Find a supervisor willing to supervise you before making a formal application.
supervisor.quote: The first step to applying for a PhD in the School of Biology is to find an academic who is willing to supervise your studies

funding.value: Funded projects include fees and stipend, but no official page says most places are funded.
funding.quote: Funded PhD projects come complete with tuition fees and stipend.

entry_route.value: An upper second-class honours degree (2.1) or a Masters degree in a relevant discipline is accepted.
entry_route.quote: You should have at least an upper second-class Honours degree (2.1), or a Masters degree, in a discipline relevant to the proposed project.
